text: % Simulate responses with both inputs acting t = kxTs; % time axis in seconds y = lsim(T_ry, r, t) + lsim(T_dy, d, t); u = lsim(T_ru, r, t) + lsim(T_du, d, t); e=r-y; % definition of error % Plots figure; plot(t, y, 'LineWidth', 1.5); grid on xlabel('k (samples)'); ylabel('y[k]"); title('Output y[k]"); figure; plot(t, u, 'LineWidth', 1.5); grid on xlabel('k (samples)'); ylabel('ulk]"); title('Control input ulkl'); figure; plot(t, e, 'LineWidth', 1.5); grid on xlabel('k (samples)'); ylabel('el[kl=r[kl-y[k]l"); title('Error el[k]');
